selection.edition: international Best Buy Developer API v1
selection.ownership: Best Buy Co., Inc., Richfield, Minnesota, United States. The reviewed edition is the official developer catalog API at api.bestbuy.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Best Buy Developer API authentication (apiKey query), Products/Stores/Categories collection and detail paths, company identity (Best Buy Co., Inc., Richfield MN), and dated incident search for Best Buy security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. The April 2018 disclosure of the 2017 [24]7.ai third-party chat vendor payment-data incident is recorded as a historical non-China event with vendor patch and customer notification. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

breach.coverage: Best Buy disclosed on 2018-04-06 that a 2017-09-27 to 2017-10-12 intrusion at third-party chat vendor [24]7.ai may have exposed a small fraction of online customer payment data. The vendor reported discovering and fixing the issue in October 2017. Best Buy notified affected customers and offered credit monitoring. Subsequent class settlement received final approval. No unresolved Best Buy Developer API compromise was identified in this 2026-09-13 review.

exception.authority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 for historical non-China incidents
exception.incident: [24]7.ai third-party chat vendor malware disclosed 2018-04-06, affecting Best Buy online customer payment data from 2017-09-27 to 2017-10-12
exception.remediation: Vendor patched October 2017; Best Buy notified affected customers, offered credit monitoring, and stated customers would not be liable for fraudulent charges. Class settlement later received final approval.
exception.residualRisk: Historical third-party payment-data exposure; live authentication unverified.
exception.adoption: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 explicitly permits historical non-China incident adoption for these Best Buy catalog reads.
exception.usefulness: Category, product, and store reads provide useful official catalog access while preserving provider JSON contracts.

research.edition: international Best Buy Developer API v1
research.searchCoverage: Official Best Buy Developer API v1 at https://api.bestbuy.com/v1, apiKey query authentication, format=json, Products/Stores/Categories collection reads, and the 2018 [24]7.ai historical incident were reviewed on 2026-09-13. Best Buy Co., Inc. is a US retailer; this edition is the official developer catalog, not a mainland-China product. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.finding: Best Buy disclosed that a 2017 intrusion at third-party chat operator [24]7.ai may have exposed names, addresses, and payment-card data for a small fraction of online customers.
incidents.remediation: Vendor reported a fix in October 2017; Best Buy notified customers and offered credit monitoring. Class settlement later received final approval.
incidents.limitation: Historical third-party vendor incident; no unresolved Developer API compromise identified in this 2026-09-13 review.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
